content: Exaane Cuwasi Yarshizaso
«Exaane cuwasi yarshizaso odoro miththafe giigsa;
izas oyddu zoozey deyo; adussateththay issi wadha, aahoteththay issi wadha, dhoqqateththay qasse nam7u wadha gido; kacetikka izara issi bolla oyketti oosettetto.
Izas bolla baggaa, oyddu milletanne kaceta ubbaa walakay baynda worqqan tiya; iza yuushonkka worqqa balxxanth yuushsha aaththa.
He balxxanththafe garsara exaane cuwasi yarshizasozas worqqafe nam7u qanggota ooththada he baggaranne ha baggara oyseththa. Heyti tookkiza wode tooho miththata gelththanaassa.
Tooho miththata odoro miththafe kessada worqqan tiya.

Ha yarshizasoza Caaqo qaalaa markkay izan diza Taabotaa sinththan kaqettida magalashaappe kare baggara, Caaqo qaala markka bollan diza atto geetettiza sohoza kama ginara woththa. Hessika tani nenara gaaggizaso.
«Aarooney maalado maalado xomppeta giigsanaas yiza wode sawiza exaane yarshizasozan cuwaso.
Aarooney omarsa wode xomppeta poo7isiza wode, zaareththidikka exaane cuwaso; histtiko exaaney GODAA sinththan yiza yeletaas ubba wode cuwattana.
Ha yarshizasozan hara digettida exaanekka, woykko xuugettiza yarsho, woykko kaththa yarsho yarshofa; ushsha yarshoka iza bolla tigoppa.

Aarooney layththan issito nagarappe maarettanaas shukkiza mehe suuth ekkidi he yarshizasoza bolla diza kaceta bolla tiyo. Histtidi geesho wogaa polo. Ha wogay sinththara yaana wodeta ubbaan layththan layththan ooththetto. Hessaththo ha yarshizasozi GODAAS dumma geeyidaso gido» gides.
Shemppo Ashshanaas Qanxxiza Miishshe
Hessafe guye GODAY Muse hizgides,
«Neni Isra7eele attuma asaa taybiza wode, issi issi asi taybettidi ba shemppo ashshanaas GODAAS miishshe immo; histtiko neni istta taybiza wode asa bolla boshay yeenna.
Taybettida attuma asay hu7en hu7en Xoossa Dunkaanen erettida maka miishsha mala koshshiza miish qanxxo. Issi issi asi baas diza mala immo.
Qoodan geliza attuma asaa layththay nam7u tammu kumidaynne hessafe bollay wuri GODAAS imota eho.
Intte intte shemppo ashshanaas GODAAS imota immishin, dureykka manqoyka issi mala immanaappe attiin, durey darssidi woykko manqoy guuththidi immofo.

Ba shemppo ashshanaas immiza miishshe Isra7eele asaappe ekkada Xoossa Dunkaaneza oosos peyshsha. Ha miishshay intte shemppo wozzanaas, GODAA sinththan Isra7eele asaa gishshas hassa7issizaaz gidana» gides.
Meechcha Kere
Hessafe guye GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Meechcha kerezanne kereza iza bolla woththiza miish xarqimalappe medhdha. Xoossa Dunkaanezappenne yarshizasozappe giddon woththada izan haath tiga.
He haaththaan Aarooneynne iza nayti ba kushenne ba toho meecettetto.
Istti hayqqontta mala Xoossa Dunkaanezan gelshe aydekka he haaththan meecettetto. Qasse GODAAS taman yarsho yarshanaas yarshizaso mata shiiqiza wode,
istti hayqqontta mala ba kushenne ba toho meecettetto. Hayssi Aaroonessinne iza zereththatas, yiza yeleta ubbaas mernaa woga gido» gides.
Tiyettiza Zayte
GODAY Muse hizgides,
«Lo7o qimameta, heytikka usuppun kilo goggiza karbbe, heedzdzu kilo sawiza qarafa, heedzdzu kilo sawiza gucachcha maatanne
usuppun kilo burgude ekka. Hayssi wurikka Xoossa Dunkaanen erettida meezaanen meezaanettidaa gido. Hessa bollaka oyddu litiro wogara zayte gujja ekka.
Heytantta shitto ooththiza mala walakkada sawiza geeshshateththas tiyettiza dumma zayte giigsa.
Histtada Xoossa Dunkaaneza, Caaqo qaalaa markkay izan diza Taabotaa,
xaraphpheezanne izan go7ettiza miishshata ubbaa, xomppe woththiza ballaanne iza miishshata, exaane cuwasi yarshizasoza,
xuugettiza yarsho yarshizasozanne izan go7ettiza miishshata ubbaa, meechcha kerenne iza woththizasoza ubbaa tiya.
Istti keehi geesh gidana mala neni istta dummasa; istta bochchizay wurikka geesh gidanaas bessees.
«Qasseka Aarooneynne iza nayti qeese gididi taas ooththana mala istta tiyada dummasa;
Isra7eele asaas, ‹Hayssi buro yaana yeletaska tiyettiza geeshsha zayte gido.
Ha zayteza hara as tiyoppa; qasse hara zayte hessaththo giigsofa. Izi dumma gidida gishshas intteka iza dummateth erite.
Hayssa mala shitto giigsiza asinne tiyettanaas bessontta hara as tiyiza asi oonikka ba asaa garsafe dhayo› ga» gides.
Exaane
Hessafe guye GODAY Muses, «Sawiza qimameta, miththa uzas, helelon diza shitto, sawiza shidanne harara walakettontta exaane ekka; istta ubbaa meezaaneykka issi gina gido.
Shitto mala walakettida exaane ooththada isttan go7etta; walakay baynda geeshshinne dumma gidana mala izan maxine yegga.

Izappe ekkada liiqisa cadda; histtada tani nenara gaaggiza Xoossa Dunkaaneza giddon Caaqo qaala markkay izan diza Taabotaa sinththan exaane cuwasi yarshizasoza bolla woththa. Izi nees ubbaafe aadhdhida geesh gidana.
Hayssa giigsidayssaththo hara exaane giigsofte. Hessi taas dumma geesh gididayssa ne era.
Hessa misatizaaz giigsidi iza sawo singidi ufayettanaas koyza asi diikko izi ba asaa garsafe dhayo» gides.
